description: Hindi/Hinglish caller, including a Hinglish price question. Replies should be Hinglish; the pricing line stays the approved English line.

turns: Namaste, main Sneha bol rahi hoon. Mujhe Baner mein apne 2BHK flat ka poora interior karwana hai, kitchen aur wardrobe bhi.
Flat lagbhag 1000 sq ft carpet ka hai.
Hum 5 mahine mein shift hona chahte hain.
Theek hai. Haan, ghar humara hai, main aur mere husband dono decide karte hain.
